summary: Acer Aspire 5 14 (Model: A514-54G-F4JH) is experiencing thermal throttling issues due to a dirty cooling system. Regular cleaning, adjusting fan settings, and monitoring temperature can help prevent this issue.
detected_fault: Thermal Throttling caused by a dirty cooling system
suggested_solution: Regularly clean the laptop's cooling system, adjust fan settings to moderate level (50-60%), and consider upgrading with aftermarket cooler
